usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa daily exchange rates
usdRate.note: WST 1 = USD 0.36171 on 30 October 2026, so 2.76 tala per US dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa statistics table 2 (Samoa Bureau of Statistics headline CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Headline CPI up 3.6% on a year earlier in August 2026 (5.7% in June); the annual-average rate the CBS headlines was 1.2% in August and September 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa Monetary Policy Statement 2026/2027 (inflation reference around 3%)
inflation_projection.note: The CBS aims for annual average inflation around 3% in line with trading partners, and recent prices have swung from -2% to +6%, so we plan with 3.5%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa (official interest rate, home page key indicators)
policy_rate.note: Official interest rate (weighted average yield on CBS securities) 3.18% in August 2026; the 2026/27 Monetary Policy Statement gives 3.42% at end April 2026 against a neutral 2-3% range.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa statistics table A14 (interest rates)
savings_account_rate.note: Commercial bank savings deposit rates range 0-2.00%; midpoint used.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa statistics table A14 (interest rates)
fdr_3m_rate.note: 3-month time deposit rates range 1.50-2.25% across banks; midpoint used.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa statistics table A14 (interest rates)
fdr_1y_rate.note: 12-month time deposit rates range 2.75-3.00% across banks; midpoint used (24 months 3.5%).

dps_rate.note: Searched CBS rate tables and bank pages: no monthly recurring deposit (DPS-style) product rate is published in Samoa.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa statistics table A14 (interest rates)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Commercial banks' weighted average deposit rate 1.63% in June 2026 (1.61% in April per the 2026/27 Monetary Policy Statement).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found in Samoa.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Samoa, tender results T-17/2026 (CBS Securities)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day CBS Securities weighted average yield 3.30% (182-day 3.69%). Samoa has no regular government Treasury bills; CBS Securities are open to registered members of the public from SAT 1,000.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No regular Samoa Government bond issues or published yields found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No regular Samoa Government bond issues or published yields found.

tax_bank_interest.note: Ministry of Revenue information sheet IS01 (2026) lists a withholding tax on interest income of resident individuals but does not state the rate; the Income Tax Act schedule was not reachable.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government retail savings bond for individuals found, so no specific tax rule applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Searched CBS publications: no deposit insurance scheme for Samoa found, and no source stating its absence.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found in CBS tables (only overall lending rates, about 8.4% weighted average).

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock market; CBS 182-day securities 3.69% and 12-month deposits 2.75-3.00%
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global equity fund in tala, near the safe rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock market; CBS 182-day securities 3.69% and 12-month deposits 2.75-3.00%
equity_return_base.note: Samoa has no stock exchange, so equity is a global index fund in tala terms: about 6%, within 4 points of the roughly 2.5-3% after-tax safe rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock market; global equities in tala terms
equity_return_high.note: High case if global equities repeat their long-run record of about 9% with a stable tala.

gold_return_low.sourceName: CBS daily exchange rates (tala per US dollar about 2.6 in 2016 and 2.76 in October 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold under a stable basket-pegged tala.

gold_return_base.sourceName: CBS daily exchange rates (tala per US dollar about 2.6 in 2016 and 2.76 in October 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus little expected tala depreciation under the basket peg.

gold_return_high.sourceName: CBS daily exchange rates (tala per US dollar about 2.6 in 2016 and 2.76 in October 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and some tala weakening.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short time deposits, allowing for the withholding tax on resident interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBS table A14: 12-month deposits 2.75-3.00%; CBS 91-day securities 3.30%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year deposits and short CBS Securities, less withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CBS table A14: 24-month deposits 3.5%; CBS 182-day securities 3.69%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 2-year deposits or 182-day CBS Securities, less withholding tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched CBS insurance supervision material: no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio published.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Life insurance is sold in Samoa, but no published per-1,000 term premium rates by age were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical private hospital bill found for Samoa; public hospital care is heavily subsidised.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table found for Samoa.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBS headline CPI table (no health sub-index published there)
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI found, so we plan with the 3.5% headline projection plus one point for imported medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBS headline CPI table (no education sub-index published there)
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI found, so we plan with the headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 72.1 for 2026 (men 70.2, women 74.1).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 10.86 (2025, World Bank), 13.8 (2040) and 11.9 (2065, populationpyramid.net/samoa/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Samoa National Provident Fund: members guide
retirement_age_default.note: SNPF members can take their savings as a lump sum or a lifetime pension at 55; no statutory private-sector retirement age found.

retirement_age_government.note: Searched for the Samoa public service retirement age: no reachable official source found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after withholding tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the 1-year deposit rate to allow for withholding tax on interest.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBS table A14: 24-month deposits 3.5%; SNPF lifetime pension option

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: SNPF: interest credited not less than 4% a year; 7-year average 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case at SNPF's statutory minimum crediting rate of 4%.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: SNPF: interest credited not less than 4% a year; 7-year average 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case between SNPF's 4% floor and its 7% average of the last seven years.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: SNPF: interest credited not less than 4% a year; 7-year average 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case at SNPF's recent 7% average crediting rate.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Samoa National Provident Fund: Senior Citizens Benefit Fund
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Monthly pension of WST 300 for life, plus free inter-island ferry travel, free consultations and medicines at government hospitals and pharmacies.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Samoa National Provident Fund: Senior Citizens Benefit Fund
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Citizens or permanent residents aged 65 and over who live in Samoa; the page lists no income or asset test.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees found in Samoa's Labour and Employment Relations Act material; retirement savings run through SNPF.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Samoa National Provident Fund: members guide
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory provident fund: 10% employee plus 10% employer; at 55 members take a lump sum or a fortnightly lifetime pension funded from 75% of net contributions (spouse receives half for up to 10 years); interest credited at no less than 4% a year.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product is published by Samoa banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found.

tbill_91d.localNameEn: Central Bank of Samoa Securities (14 to 365 days)
tbill_91d.note: Central bank bills sold by fortnightly tender; open to registered members of the public from SAT 1,000; used here in place of government Treasury bills.

tbond_5y.note: No regular government bond issues to the public found.

tbond_10y.note: No regular government bond issues to the public found.

equity_fund.note: Samoa has no stock exchange; a locally managed unit trust and offshore funds are the main pooled options.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mainly sold as jewellery.

insuranceComplaints.name: Central Bank of Samoa
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman found; complaints go to the insurer, then the Central Bank.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Senior Citizens Benefit Fund (administered by SNPF)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (government hospitals; free consultations for seniors)
